top_examples.hook: My girlfriend said she packed me sweet lunch notes, but every message I opened sounded like she was furious with me.
top_examples.premise: A man discovers that the handwritten notes his girlfriend leaves in his lunch keep being replaced with much harsher messages before he opens them.

top_examples.hook: A restaurant accused me of cheating its rewards program because I somehow ate thirty-seven dinners in a city I hadn't visited.
top_examples.premise: A man keeps receiving restaurant loyalty points for expensive dinners he never ate, then gets accused of abusing the rewards program.

top_examples.hook: The storage manager bought my unit at his own auction. I found my dining table in his house listing while automatic payments were still leaving my account.

top_examples.hook: My boss put my salary on the office scoreboard. Then he announced whoever closed the biggest deal by Friday would take home the money I had already earned.
top_examples.premise: A company withholds an employee's earned salary and publicly offers the exact amount as a sales prize for her coworkers.
top_examples.title: My Salary Became the Office Sales Prize

top_examples.hook: I opened my freezer and found three bags of meat half thawed for the second time in a month.
